## Checklist

### General
- [ ] I have tested my changes locally
- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines
- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING](../CONTRIBUTING.md) guide

### For New Themes
- [ ] Theme has a unique `PROFILE_UUID` (generate with `uuidgen`)
- [ ] Theme has a descriptive `PROFILE_NAME`
- [ ] Theme file is named using lowercase and hyphens (e.g., `my-theme-dark.sh`)
- [ ] Color palette has all 16 colors defined
- [ ] Theme installs correctly via `install.sh`
- [ ] Theme appears in GNOME Terminal preferences

### For Script Changes
- [ ] Scripts pass ShellCheck without errors
- [ ] Scripts work with both local and remote installation
- [ ] No hardcoded paths or credentials
